label: Grounded entry into the perfection-transfer cycle; nonuniversal transfer isolated as the leaf
summary: Cycle map (#1476, PR #1480): unrestricted transfer f8ba2429 had one non-transcription proof, CAUSAL-PERFECTION-TRANSFER-RECONSTRUCTION (fc46c3ea), from universal-scope transfer b26c10a0 and the residual 5a4afaa5 (case split on decided universality and identity). The residual had one, CAUSAL-PERFECTION-TRANSFER-DELTA-FORWARD (3952799d), a projection of f8ba2429. Both directions are genuine but the residual is by construction the scope delta of f8ba2429 over b26c10a0, so the cycle had no entry; b26c10a0 itself is grounded (from total causation, dae70d8a; its projection from f8ba2429 is a transcription). Grounded entry: the residual's two conjuncts were separated. Its self-effect conjunct is vacuous under the existing open premise STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-BEING (b62a64ab), already on root routes. Its nonuniversal conjunct has no derivation from premises outside the cycle without a premise at least as strong as itself on the nonuniversal cases: the only candidate found, that only a universal cause causes anything's esse (which makes it vacuous), is stronger and faces q.104 a.1, read in the prior investigation (docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q104-A1-EN), which credits particular created causes with causing being (sun and illuminated air); it was not registered. The conjunct is therefore registered as its own open premise, NonuniversalPerfectionTransfer (10cd24ed), and f8ba2429 is derived from excluded middle, b26c10a0, 10cd24ed and b62a64ab (result a3d5fb1a: x is not c by no self-causation of esse; case split on universality). f8ba2429 and 5a4afaa5 now close as proved from open premises; 10cd24ed is the new bare leaf. Controls (40f6a49b): each nonlogical premise is needed in an explicit interpretation (part 1 reuses the concurrent background model 66aab41c), 10cd24ed is strictly weaker than the residual, and all premises hold nonvacuously with an actual nonuniversal esse edge. Better-motivated leaf: of the two cycle members, neither should stand as the leaf. The q.4 a.2 and q.6 a.2 support claims on f8ba2429 bear on the first, universal cause, i.e. on b26c10a0's scope; the residual had no warrant of its own. 10cd24ed is strictly weaker than the residual and carries exactly the content with no warrant on file. Objection audit (substantive objection standard, both ways): against 10cd24ed, no substantive objection identified; its rival (a particular sustainer of esse that does not cause a perfection another agent causes) is a formal alternative only (control part 1), with no read source giving a case. There is also no positive warrant: the strongest positive argument on file for transfer (participation plus active concurrence, q.105 a.5, read in the prior investigation) rests on the source being the universal first agent that applies every agent to its operation, and a nonuniversal cause by definition lacks that universal scope; that is the specific difference that keeps the argument for b26c10a0 from extending to 10cd24ed. This is an absence of warrant, not evidence against the premise. Against b62a64ab, no substantive objection on file; causa sui (Descartes, Fourth Replies) is an unread lead with no weight. Excluded middle is the existing self-evident premise with a met floor basis. No premise is established.
blocker: 10cd24ed (nonuniversal transfer) has no derivation and no warrant on file. Next tests: (1) re-route the consumers of f8ba2429 (44 arguments) to b26c10a0 where universal scope suffices, as docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md already did for naming, reduced description and goodness, and record which consumers need unrestricted transfer (candidate: perfection preexistence from causal transfer, 6b609ddc, which quantifies over every cause of esse); (2) test an instrumental-causation bridge (a particular cause of esse acts as an instrument of the universal cause, so the perfection it fails to cause is still caused by the universal cause), which would bear on preexistence rather than on 10cd24ed; source lead De potentia q.3 a.7, unread.
